top_headline: العنوان: القاهرة للدواجن (POUL.CA) دعوة الجمعية العامة غير العادية المقرر انعقادها في 30/11/2026 في تمام الساعة 03:00 مساءًاسم الشركة: القاهرة ل - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- Cairo Poultry's stock has seen a significant decline, with a 17% drop in value, leading it to be the most declined stock on the Egyptian stock exchange.
- The company's nine-month profit has dropped by 38.3%, indicating a substantial decrease in earnings.
- Despite a rise in revenues of approximately 1.1% to EGP 12.1 billion, Cairo Poultry's net profit for the first nine months of 2026 fell by 39% to EGP 1.44 billion.
- The Egyptian stock exchange has set price limits for Cairo Poultry's stock, allowing a 35.19% downward movement and a 27.09% temporary suspension.
- Investors have until the end of Sunday, November 15, 2026, to purchase Cairo Poultry shares and receive a cash distribution of EGP 1.89 per share, payable on November 18, 2026.
- Cairo Poultry's third-quarter consolidated profit was EGP 152 million.
- The small and medium-sized company index on the stock exchange fell by more than 2% during Monday's mid-session, driven by a decline in most of the index's stocks, led by Cairo Poultry.
- These developments may impact investor confidence and stock performance, especially with the significant profit drop and the stock's recent performance.
